### Wives for Benjamin
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/wives-benjamin
Passage: Judges 21:25
Points:
- Israel's civil war against Benjamin left the tribe on the brink of extinction.
- Trapped by a rash oath, the Israelites turned to brutal workarounds instead of humble repentance.
- They massacred the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead and arranged the abduction of dancers at Shiloh.
- Such perverse rationalizations demonstrate the chaos of people acting according to their own eyes.
- Believers need King Jesus to reign in their hearts so they do not justify their own sin.

### When Our Opinions and Feelings Get Us in Trouble
Author: Lysa TerKeurst
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-january-28-2021.html
Passage: Judges 21:25
Points:
- Spiritual shallowness leaves people vulnerable to collapse when cultural storms hit.
- Relying on personal opinions rather than divine truth leads to compromise and self-deception.
- Emotions should serve as reminders to seek God rather than masters that dictate decisions.
- Humans inevitably break under the crushing burden of attempting to be their own god.
- True spiritual stability comes from trusting King Jesus and grounding life in God's Word.

### Devotional: Judges 21
Author: D.A. Carson
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/devotionals/read-the-bible/judges-21-acts-25-jeremiah-35-psalms-7-8/
Passage: Judges 21:1-25
Points:
- Vengeance against Benjamin created a national crisis that threatened to erase a whole tribe.
- Israel devised cruel, self-serving schemes to provide wives while nominally keeping their rash vow.
- These violent and coercive solutions inflicted severe generational grief, bitterness, and trauma.
- The root problem across Judges was persistent spiritual rebellion and abandonment of God's covenant.
- The desperate need for a righteous king anticipates Christ as King of kings.

### Our disastrous rightness
Author: Ray Ortlund
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/blogs/ray-ortlund/judges-2125_06/
Passage: Judges 21:25
Points:
- The chaos of Judges came not from people intending evil, but from doing what felt right.
- Relying on gut feelings and self-guided moral fervor consistently leads to ruin.
- Aligning our perspective with God's view requires honest humility and repentance.
- Diligent study of Scripture allows King Jesus to shepherd believers away from self-destructive choices.
